secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Browser-side Supabase project URL (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL)

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Browser-side Supabase anon/publishable key (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → anon public key)

secrets.name: VITE_PROFESSOR_VERIFICATION_CODE
secrets.description: Six-digit PIN that verifies instructor logins (set by the project owner)

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Server-side Supabase project URL (same as VITE_SUPABASE_URL)

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Server-side Supabase service-role/secret key (Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → service_role key)
